clips.title: The story
paras: In southeastern Dun Morogh, Helm's Bed Lake lies frozen beneath the hills. Dwarves keep a hole open in its ice for fresh water, while beasts, troggs, and hostile Dark Iron dwarves threaten the shore.

Helm's Bed Lake lies beneath winter ice in southeastern Dun Morogh. Local dwarves keep an opening chopped through the frost so they can draw clean, fresh water. The frozen surface is stable enough to cross, but the banks are dangerous. Wild beasts roam the edges, displaced troggs scavenge along the ridges, and hostile Dark Iron dwarves have taken an abandoned lodge just south of the water. They ambush travelers who pass through.
